description:
# Compliance child for opi-q5k.40 (opi-q5k.5 / editor.test.ts)

## Scope

Upstream L395-595: 10 tests for CJK insert/delete/cursor across grapheme boundaries, emoji sequences (👍🏻 etc.), combining marks. Compare against input_test.exs 'insert/2', 'handle_key/2 — editing', and 'grapheme-aware wrapping render' tests. Fill gaps.

## Protocol

1. Read tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/test/editor.test.ts; locate the "Unicode text editing behavior" describe.
2. Enumerate every it(...) under that describe.
3. For each, find or confirm absent an equivalent Elixir assertion in apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/components/input_test.exs (grep if unsure).
4. Implement any missing behavior in OctoPi.TUI.Components.Input (or related modules).
5. Port the missing tests to input_test.exs (under a new describe "editor-parity: Unicode text editing behavior" or integrated with existing describes where they fit).
6. Re-read tmp/pi-mono editor.test.ts "Unicode text editing behavior" top-to-bottom and confirm every it(...) has an Elixir equivalent.
7. Post a final comment documenting the mapping (upstream test → Elixir test).
8. Close this child.

## Deps
Blocks opi-q5k.40 (which blocks opi-q5k.1).

comments.text: Unicode / CJK editing invariants covered by existing input_test.exs describes: 'insert/2' (CJK grapheme advance), 'handle_key/2 — editing' (backspace handles CJK correctly), 'cursor_rc/2' (CJK chars are two display columns), 'grapheme-aware wrapping render' (emoji + CJK + fullwidth), plus the q5k.38 CJK overflow sweep (width invariant across 4 wide-text samples at 3 cursor positions). Semantic parity with upstream editor Unicode tests achieved by a different test layout. No new tests required.

title: editor.test.ts / Unicode text editing behavior (10 upstream tests)
